title: Titanium Trim Tab Hydraulic Ram End
function: High-speed trim tab hydraulic cylinder ram end
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400) is used for Titanium Trim Tab Hydraulic Ram End where immunity to seawater pitting corrosion (no critical pitting temperature up to 260°C) is mandatory. Unlike super-duplex stainless steels, Ti-6Al-4V suffers no chloride stress corrosion cracking in marine environments even at elevated temperatures. Its yield strength (830 MPa) enables 40% wall thickness reduction vs 316L for equivalent pressure ratings, directly reducing subsea component mass — critical for High-speed trim tab hydraulic cylinder ram end. This rationale is driven by high-speed trim tab hydraulic cylinder ram end and fat life requirements.
process: Ring forging radial-axial for propulsion geometry
CNC turn-bore operation with 0.5mm corner radius
TIG welding autogenous with 0.5mm corner radius
Hydrostatic pressure test with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Heavy-duty passivation 25% HNO3 45min per ASTM B600 for maximum chloride pitting resistance in seawater — tailored for highspeed trim tab application
commonFailures: HE from over-protection below -0.85V vs Ag/AgCl - controlled by anode current density limiter circuit — critical for highspeed trim tab performance

faq.q: What is the seawater corrosion rate of Titanium Trim Tab Hydraulic Ram End?
faq.a: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V exhibits a general corrosion rate of <0.01 mm/year in quiescent seawater and <0.05 mm/year in high-flow (5 m/s) seawater. Unlike stainless steels, Titanium Trim Tab Hydraulic Ram End is immune to chloride stress corrosion cracking and pitting corrosion up to 260°C. For highspeed trim tab in submerged service, no cathodic protection is required — a significant cost advantage over steel and aluminum.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Trim Tab Hydraulic Ram End?

Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for highspeed trim tab.
